title: Fatherhood of God
definition: The Fatherhood of God means God relates to His people with covenant love, authority, care, discipline, provision, and welcome through Christ.
summary: The Fatherhood of God means God relates to His people with covenant love, authority, care, discipline, provision, and welcome through Christ.
christFocus: Jesus reveals the Father and brings believers into sonship, so those who belong to Christ may come to God not as unwanted strangers but as beloved children.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture reveals God as Father in a way that is holy, faithful, and tender. His Fatherhood is not built from broken human examples; human fatherhood is meant to reflect Him, not define Him.

For those in Christ, the Father gives welcome, provision, correction, identity, and inheritance. He is not distant from His children, and He does not abandon the weak, wounded, or overlooked.

Jesus is the eternal Son who makes the Father known. Through Him, believers receive adoption, and by the Holy Spirit they cry, 'Abba, Father.'

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people carry wounds from absent, harsh, unsafe, or disappointing fathers. This doctrine does not minimize those wounds; it shows that God the Father is better, truer, safer, and holier than the failures people have known.

It also corrects the lie that believers must live like spiritual orphans. In Christ, God's people are wanted, received, corrected in love, and kept by the Father.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Bring your view of fatherhood under Scripture rather than pain alone. Come to the Father through Christ, ask the Spirit to heal false views of God, and learn to live as a loved child who can trust, obey, and rest in Him.
